title: Watertown High School's cross country teams host home invitational
text: SPORTSMore than 700 runners take part in Watoma Invite cross country meet Roger MerriamUpdated Oct. 1, 2026, 9:50 p.m. CTAberdeen Central and Watertown runners take off at the start of the varsity girls' 5,000-meter race during the Watoma Invitational cross country meet on Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026 at Cattail Crossing Golf Course in Watertown. Some of the Aberdeen Central runners are Grace Preszler (5553), Allie Novstrup (5547) and Allison Brenner (5527). Watertown's contingent includes Jayda Jensen (5986), Grace McElroy (5988), Kate McElroy (5989), Grace List (5987), Lilly Gerlach (5985) and Olivia Anderson (5982), among others.Roger Merriam/Public OpinionAberdeen Central's Allison Brenner, far right, tries to pass a group of runners in the varsity girls' 5,000-meter race during the Watoma Invitational cross country meet on Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026 at Cattail Crossing Golf Course in Watertown.Roger Merriam/Public OpinionWatertown runners Iver Pospisil (5973), Grady Lindgren (5964) and Jace Mashburn attempt to pass a Huron runner in the varsity boys' 5,000-meter race during the Watoma Invitational cross country meet on Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026 at Cattail Crossing Golf Course in Watertown.Roger Merriam/Public OpinionHarrisburg's Brianna Reilly leads runners, from left, Kaylie Kuehl of Brookings, Sadie Pettengill of Sioux Falls Christian and Hannah Genrich of Harrisburg on the way to winning the varsity girls' 5,000-meter run during the Watoma Invitational cross country meet on Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026 at Cattail Crossing Golf Course in Watertown.
